title: Aquino and Phoenix program psychological warfare in Vietnam
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Aquino and Phoenix program psychological warfare in Vietnam, about Vietnam War at Vietnam, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: a psychological warfare operations officer in Vietnam, right? >> The Phoenix program. He was involved in the Phoenix program.

plain: A writer and researcher named Peter Levenda, on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that a man named Michael Aquino served as a psychological warfare officer during the Vietnam War. Levenda says Aquino was part of the Phoenix program, a wartime operation in Vietnam, and he draws on his own book, The Lovecraft Code, for the story. He raises it to link military mind-influence work with the wider themes of his research.
